name: Earthquake
description: A powerful earthquake strikes, damaging buildings and infrastructure.

name: Flood
description: Heavy rains cause widespread flooding, displacing people and damaging crops.

name: Drought
description: Prolonged lack of rain dries up water supplies and destroys harvests.

name: Hurricane
description: A violent storm with destructive winds and heavy rain hits coastal areas.

name: Wildfire
description: Uncontrolled wildfires burn forests, homes and farmland.

name: Heatwave
description: Extreme heat strains power grids, health services and water supplies.

name: Crop Failure
description: Pests and poor weather ruin harvests, pushing food prices up.

name: Energy Shortage
description: Power plants and fuel supplies fall short of demand, causing blackouts.

name: Recession
description: Economic activity contracts, unemployment rises and tax revenue falls.

name: Pandemic
description: A fast-spreading disease crosses borders, overwhelming hospitals.

name: Supply Chain Disruption
description: Ports and shipping lanes are disrupted, delaying goods and raising prices.

name: Financial Crisis
description: Banks and markets lose confidence, credit dries up and investment falls.

name: Refugee Crisis
description: Large numbers of displaced people arrive, straining housing and services.

name: Influenza
description: Seasonal influenza spreads, raising hospital admissions.

name: Cholera
description: Contaminated water spreads cholera, threatening public health.

name: Dengue
description: Mosquito-borne dengue fever spreads in warm, wet regions.

name: Malaria
description: Malaria cases rise, burdening clinics and the workforce.
